name: Musical Instruments In Church
overview: Scripture reveals that musical instruments have a God-ordained role in worship, as seen in Genesis 4:21 where Jubal is recognized as the father of those skilled in playing the harp and organ. The Psalms emphasize praising God with joyful noise and skillful playing of instruments such as trumpets, psalteries, and harps (Psalms 33:3; 98:4; 150:1, 3). Furthermore, Acts 16:25 illustrates that singing praises to God, even in difficult circumstances, is a powerful act of worship. Together, these verses affirm that musical instruments are a biblical means to express heartfelt praise and glorify God within the church.
